in_sanskrit.name: Kanubhai
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Kanu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kanubhai एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kanu’ meaning ‘Lord’ and ‘Bhai’ meaning ‘Brother’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Kanu is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, who is revered as the protector and sustainer of the universe.
